propositions: Type-tier comparability allows task T and story S (both direct children of epic E) to escalate T-to-S to E-to-S, escaping the redundancy guard and writing an invalid epic-blocks-child edge (bug 1803-df54-18bb-4881)
Redundancy check is evaluated on the original source/target pair before promotion, not on the resolved pair actually written, allowing ancestor-blocking edges to escape rejection
Structural NCA-based comparability with virtual-root sentinel resolves blocking links between two endpoints by escalating each to its ancestor that is a direct child of their nearest common ancestor

Post-resolution ancestor-descendant redundancy check rejects all blocking pairs where one endpoint is an ancestor of the other, including previously-escaped cases where promotion crosses ancestor boundaries
_get_ancestors with uncapped depth and cycle-guard terminates deep chains at the true root instead of fallback-to-chain-root, enabling correct NCA resolution for 4+ level hierarchies
Non-blocking relations (relates_to, supersedes, discovered_from) retain original-pair redundancy evaluation and gain no new rejections under the widened ancestor-descendant predicate
